summary: Validated 5 new features (Export Laporan, Daily Telegram, Track Order, Pelanggan tab, Affiliate Export). Backend: 26/26 pytest in new suite + 28/28 prior suites = 54/54 PASS. Frontend: /lacak-pesanan page, NavBar+Footer links, Admin Export Panel (real download triggered with correct filename), Pelanggan tab, Affiliate per-row + bulk export dialog all verified. Scheduler 'daily_telegram_summary' confirmed registered in startup log. 1 UI bug found: double 'Rp Rp' prefix on Admin Dashboard stat cards.

ui_bugs.component: AdminPanel Dashboard stat cards (HARI INI / 7 HARI / 30 HARI / KOMISI EARNED / KOMISI TERBAYAR)
ui_bugs.issue: Currency displays as 'Rp Rp 15.000' / 'Rp Rp 91.068' — duplicate 'Rp' prefix because formatter prepends 'Rp ' to a value that already starts with 'Rp'. Affects all 5 omzet/komisi cards on Dashboard.

issues: Numeric formatting: comma vs dot inconsistency (91.068 vs 91,068) — using IDN locale dots looks like decimals to international users; double Rp prefix

action_items: Fix double 'Rp Rp' prefix in AdminPanel Dashboard stat cards — likely in formatRupiah call where value already includes 'Rp' (probably the dashboard renders `Rp ${formatRupiah(value)}` while formatRupiah already returns 'Rp 15.000').
critical_code_review_comments: exports.py XLSX generators properly use bold gold-on-navy header (matches brand palette) + auto column width with min 10/max 50; CSV uses utf-8-sig (BOM) for Excel-Indonesia compatibility — good.
_safe_sheet correctly strips forbidden chars [/]:*?\\ and dedupes with ' (n)' suffix capped to 28 chars — verified by test_bulk_xlsx_unique_sheets.

scheduler.py uses APScheduler AsyncIOScheduler with Asia/Jakarta cron(8,0); job id 'daily_telegram_summary' confirmed in supervisor log: 'Daily Telegram summary scheduler started (08:00 WIB)'. build_daily_summary correctly converts WIB midnight->UTC ISO for matching.
/track-order is properly PUBLIC (no Header check). _public_order_view correctly strips sensitive fields (contact, pakasir_qr_string, commission_amount, payment_method internals). Good.

/track-order contact normalization tries [raw, digits, digits.lstrip('0'), '62' + digits.lstrip('0'), digits.lstrip('62')] — covers most IDN WA formats but `digits.lstrip('62')` is fragile (will strip '62' from e.g. '6212345' even when user meant '6212345'). Acceptable trade-off but document.
/admin/customers aggregation pipeline correctly sums only confirmed orders for total_spent via $cond — matches requirement.
/admin/export/customers reuses admin_customers(q=None,...) function call — DRY but couples HTTP-decorated handler internals; consider extracting `_compute_customers()` helper for cleaner separation.
_parse_period for custom range correctly returns 400 on invalid YYYY-MM-DD — verified.
Minor: server.py is now ~1360 lines (was 1055). Split into routers/exports.py + routers/tracking.py + routers/customers.py is overdue.
Frontend Admin Dashboard double 'Rp' bug suggests the currency helper isn't centralized — extract a single formatRupiah(amount) util and use everywhere.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all new features render & integrate correctly; 1 cosmetic bug (Rp Rp duplication)

rca of the issue: Cosmetic 'Rp Rp' bug RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.jsx Dashboard JSX, the stat-card amount is rendered as something like `Rp {formatRupiah(today.revenue)}` while formatRupiah() already returns a string prefixed with 'Rp ' (e.g. 'Rp 15.000'), producing 'Rp Rp 15.000'. Fix: either drop the literal 'Rp ' in JSX OR change formatRupiah to return raw number formatting. Repro: visit /admin -> login -> Dashboard tab -> observe the 5 stat cards.
